[review:efficiency] changed list in reconcile result is uncapped; a huge merge-up prints thousands of paths.
[review:design] a design-check row whose board cannot be resolved no longer falls back to task-Touches covers.
[review:efficiency] findComponent re-walks the component library once per name per board.
[review:design] a directory cover (trailing slash) relates differently than a file cover to a new sibling, so component-directory boards narrow less.
